<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Political opposition to cultural changes:</strong> Former Odisha CM Naveen Patnaik has criticized the central government for changing the Indian hockey team&#x27;s jersey color from blue to saffron, sparking a debate over national symbols.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Executive governance and rhetoric:</strong> Prime Minister Modi held a high-level meeting with top ministers, while political tensions persist as Haryana CM Saini accused the INDIA bloc of maintaining double standards.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
